senses.en: the first known nerve agent, synthesized by German chemists in 1936; a highly toxic combustible liquid that is soluble in organic solvents and is used as a nerve gas in chemical warfare
senses.zh: 最早已知的神经毒剂,由德国化学家于1936年合成; 一种剧毒可燃液体,可溶于有机溶剂,在化学战中用作神经毒气.

senses.en: a rare silvery (usually trivalent) metallic element; brittle at low temperatures but liquid above room temperature; occurs in trace amounts in bauxite and zinc ores
senses.zh: 一种稀有的银质(通常是三价)金属元素; 低温时脆化,但液体高于室温; 以微量形式在铝土和锌矿中发生
